newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 falls more than 50 pts as Dow drops.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 falls more than 50 pts as Dow drops.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index extended its early loss mid afternoon on Thursday as a renewed bout of interest rate jitters sent Wall Street sharply lower.
The blue chip UK index was down 57.4 points at 4,274.8 by 1509 GMT, with the Dow down 49.85 points at 6,824.81.

Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan signalled a possible rate rise at next week's policy-making session, warning that the economy retains a "great deal of vigour" and that a further drop in unemployment would increase the risk of higher wages and prices.
Greenspan said the U.S. must act pre-emptively to keep inflation low.
By 1519 GMT the FTSE 100 was down 61.3 points at 4,270.9, its lowest level since February 7.
